messages:
alex: Running into a reproducible dup POST + 401 pattern in the sample app when toggling network during signin. Pixel 7A on Android 13/15 shows it frequently after a cold start.

alex: Repro steps: launch app, start signin, toggle wifi off -> mobile on while token refresh is inflight. Observed server side: duplicate side-effecting POSTs.

alex: Our AuthInterceptor is simple: 
```
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = TokenProvider.getSyncToken() // blocking refresh if expired
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder().addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```

alex: Snippet from logs: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=9001
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 /api/submit id=9001
I/TokenRefresher: refresh start
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=9001 <- duplicate enqueue
I/TokenRefresher: refresh done
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=9002 (retry after refresh)
```

maria: Are you using Retrofit suspend adapter + coroutines? Any custom CallAdapter that might re-enqueue on resume? Also check callTimeout vs readTimeout interplay.

alex: Using Retrofit suspend adapter, no custom enqueue logic. Timeouts are defaults. Behavior correlates with connectivity broadcasts.

kendall: Any code that reuses Request objects or recreates OkHttpClient inside TokenProvider? Also, weirdly, we once saw minify causing odd behavior by stripping synthetic methods used by generated coroutine bridges. Is debug build minified?

alex: Crap, sampleapp debug had minifyEnabled turned on accidentally. Turning it off reduces dupes to basically zero in my runs. With minify true dupes ~60%.

sam: That suggests R8 is optimizing something that changes timing or inlines a bridge used by the interceptor chain. Recommend adding explicit -keep rules for token classes and interceptor packages while we investigate.

maria: Can you produce two APKs (minified and non-minified) with a small harness that toggles connectivity for CI reproduction? We'll need logs plus a deterministic script.

ci-bot: Note: adding an e2e test that toggles connectivity will increase CI flakiness/time. Consider making it a nightly optional job first.

alex: Immediate action: disable minify in debug, add README note, and open an issue with repro artifacts. Pushing logs & APKs now.

kendall: Suggested proguard keep rules to try: 
```
-keep class com.redwood.sample.auth.** { *; }
-keepclassmembers class okhttp3.** { *; }
```
Tighten after repro analysis. Also add a deduping layer around token refresh (single inflight refresh) to avoid double retries.

sam: Also ensure TokenProvider.getSyncToken() doesn't create a new OkHttpClient or call execute() on the same Request twice. Use a single OkHttpClient shared across the app and build fresh Request objects.

alex: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/101 with APKs/logs and repro instructions. Temporarily leaving minify disabled on debug.

runtime-bot: FYI we recently bumped okhttp in runtime; dispatcher wake ordering changed slightly. Tagging eng-runtime.

eng-runtime: We couldn't reproduce duplicate enqueues in our harness but we'll pair with the devex team on the APKs. Good call adding keep rules and single-flight refresh.

alex: Scheduling pairing session with eng-runtime tomorrow. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
